proofTerm:
by
  intro p n hp hn hdiv hmin
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hzmod_dvd (a : ℕ) : ((a : ZMod p) = 0 ↔ p ∣ a) := by
    exact ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff a p
  let x : ZMod p := n
  have hroot_sub : x ^ 6 - 1 = 0 := by
    have h0 : ((n ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := (hzmod_dvd (n ^ 6 - 1)).mpr hdiv
    have hcast : ((n ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x ^ 6 - 1 := by
      dsimp [x]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ n ^ 6 by
        exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n) 6))]
      simp
    rw [hcast] at h0
    exact h0
  have hroot : x ^ 6 = 1 := by
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hroot_sub
  have hfactor : (x - 1) * (x + 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) * (x ^ 2 - x + 1) = 0 := by
    calc
      (x - 1) * (x + 1) * (x ^ 2 + x + 1) * (x ^ 2 - x + 1) = x ^ 6 - 1 := by ring
      _ = 0 := hroot_sub
  have hcases : (x - 1 = 0) ∨ (x + 1 = 0) ∨ (x ^ 2 + x + 1 = 0) ∨ (x ^ 2 - x + 1 = 0) := by
    have h := hfactor
    rw [mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero] at h
    tauto
  have hle_n_sq : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
    calc
      n = n * 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ n * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (by omega : 1 ≤ n)
      _ = n ^ 2 := by simp [pow_two]
  have hdivs : p ∣ (n - 1) ∨ p ∣ (n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) := by
    rcases hcases with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
    · left
      apply (hzmod_dvd (n - 1)).mp
      have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x - 1 := by
        dsimp [x]
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
        simp
      rw [hcast]
      exact h1
    · right
      left
      apply (hzmod_dvd (n + 1)).mp
      have hcast : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x + 1 := by
        dsimp [x]
        simp
      rw [hcast]
      exact h2
    · right
      right
      left
      apply (hzmod_dvd (n ^ 2 + n + 1)).mp
      have hcast : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x ^ 2 + x + 1 := by
        dsimp [x]
        simp [pow_two]
      rw [hcast]
      exact h3
    · right
      right
      right
      apply (hzmod_dvd (n ^ 2 - n + 1)).mp
      have hcast : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x ^ 2 - x + 1 := by
        dsimp [x]
        rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hle_n_sq]
        simp [pow_two]
      rw [hcast]
      exact h4
  have source_step_0 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n + 1) ∨ p ∣ (n - 1) ∨ p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) := by
    rcases hdivs with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4
    · right; right; left; exact h1
    · right; left; exact h2
    · left; exact h3
    · right; right; right; exact h4
  have source_step_1 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) → (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hzero : x ^ 2 + x + 1 = 0 := by
      have hcast : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x ^ 2 + x + 1 := by
        dsimp [x]
        simp [pow_two]
      have h0 : ((n ^ 2 + n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := (hzmod_dvd (n ^ 2 + n + 1)).mpr hcase
      rw [hcast] at h0
      exact h0
    have hrel : x + 1 = - x ^ 2 := by
      calc
        x + 1 = (x ^ 2 + x + 1) - x ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = - x ^ 2 := by rw [hzero]; ring
    have hx1 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x + 1 := by
      dsimp [x]
      simp
    calc
      (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = (x + 1) ^ 6 := by rw [hx1]
      _ = (- x ^ 2) ^ 6 := by rw [hrel]
      _ = (x ^ 2) ^ 6 := by ring
      _ = (x ^ 6) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hroot]; ring
  have source_step_2 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 + n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hpow : (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = 1 := source_step_1 hcase
    apply (hzmod_dvd ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1)).mp
    have hcast : (((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ 6 by
        exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n + 1) 6))]
      simp
    rw [hcast, hpow]
    ring
  have source_step_3 : p ∣ (n + 1) → (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hzero : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := (hzmod_dvd (n + 1)).mpr hcase
    have htwo : ((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      have hnat : n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 := by omega
      rw [hnat, Nat.cast_add]
      simp [hzero]
    calc
      (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = (1 : ZMod p) ^ 6 := by rw [htwo]
      _ = 1 := by ring
  have source_step_4 : p ∣ (n + 1) → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hpow : (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = 1 := source_step_3 hcase
    apply (hzmod_dvd ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1)).mp
    have hcast : (((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((n + 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ (n + 2) ^ 6 by
        exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n + 2) 6))]
      simp
    rw [hcast, hpow]
    ring
  have source_step_5 : p ∣ (n - 1) → (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hzero : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := (hzmod_dvd (n - 1)).mpr hcase
    have hcast1 : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
      simp
    have hx1 : (n : ZMod p) = 1 := by
      have hsub : (n : ZMod p) - 1 = 0 := by
        rw [← hcast1]
        exact hzero
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
    have hneg : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
      have hcast2 : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p) - 2 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 2 ≤ n)]
        norm_num
      rw [hcast2, hx1]
      ring
    calc
      (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = (-1 : ZMod p) ^ 6 := by rw [hneg]
      _ = 1 := by ring
  have source_step_6 : p ∣ (n - 1) → 4 ≤ n → False := by
    intro hcase hn4
    have hpow : (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = 1 := source_step_5 hcase
    have hdvd : p ∣ ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
      apply (hzmod_dvd ((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1)).mp
      have hcast : (((n - 2) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ (n - 2) ^ 6 by
          exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n - 2) 6))]
        simp
      rw [hcast, hpow]
      ring
    have hgt : 1 < n - 2 := by omega
    have hle : n ≤ n - 2 := hmin (n - 2) hgt hdvd
    omega
  have source_step_7 : p ∣ (n - 1) → n = 3 := by
    intro hcase
    have hnot4 : ¬ 4 ≤ n := by
      intro hn4
      exact source_step_6 hcase hn4
    have hn_cases : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by omega
    rcases hn_cases with hn2 | hn3
    · exfalso
      subst n
      have hpdiv1 : p ∣ 1 := by simpa using hcase
      have hp_le_one : p ≤ 1 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 1) hpdiv1
      have hp_gt_one : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
      omega
    · exact hn3
  have source_step_8 : p ∣ (n - 1) → n = 3 → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase hn3
    subst n
    have hpd2 : p ∣ 2 := by simpa using hcase
    have hp_le2 : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 2) hpd2
    have hp_gt1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
    have hp_eq2 : p = 2 := by omega
    rw [hp_eq2]
    norm_num
  have source_step_9 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 = 1) := by
    intro hcase
    have hzero0 : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := (hzmod_dvd (n ^ 2 - n + 1)).mpr hcase
    have hpoly : ((n ^ 2 - n + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x ^ 2 - x + 1 := by
      dsimp [x]
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hle_n_sq]
      simp [pow_two]
    have hzero : x ^ 2 - x + 1 = 0 := by
      rw [hpoly] at hzero0
      exact hzero0
    have hrel : x - 1 = x ^ 2 := by
      calc
        x - 1 = x ^ 2 - (x ^ 2 - x + 1) := by ring
        _ = x ^ 2 := by rw [hzero]; ring
    have hcastn : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = x - 1 := by
      dsimp [x]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ n)]
      simp
    calc
      (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = (x - 1) ^ 6 := by rw [hcastn]
      _ = (x ^ 2) ^ 6 := by rw [hrel]
      _ = (x ^ 6) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [hroot]; ring
  have source_step_10 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → n = 2 := by
    intro hcase
    have hnot3 : ¬ 3 ≤ n := by
      intro hn3
      have hpow : (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6) = 1 := source_step_9 hcase
      have hdvd : p ∣ ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1) := by
        apply (hzmod_dvd ((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1)).mp
        have hcast : (((n - 1) ^ 6 - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) ^ 6 - 1) := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ (n - 1) ^ 6 by
            exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (pow_pos (by omega : 0 < n - 1) 6))]
          simp
        rw [hcast, hpow]
        ring
      have hgt : 1 < n - 1 := by omega
      have hle : n ≤ n - 1 := hmin (n - 1) hgt hdvd
      omega
    omega
  have source_step_11 : p ∣ (n ^ 2 - n + 1) → n = 2 → p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    intro hcase hn2
    subst n
    have hpd3 : p ∣ 3 := by simpa using hcase
    have hp_le3 : p ≤ 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 3) hpd3
    have hp_gt1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
    have hp_cases : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by omega
    rcases hp_cases with hp2 | hp3
    · subst p
      norm_num at hpd3
    · rw [hp3]
      norm_num
  have source_step_12 : p ∣ ((n + 1) ^ 6 - 1) ∨ p ∣ ((n + 2) ^ 6 - 1) := by
    rcases source_step_0 with hcase1 | hcase2 | hcase3 | hcase4
    · left
      exact source_step_2 hcase1
    · right
      exact source_step_4 hcase2
    · right
      exact source_step_8 hcase3 (source_step_7 hcase3)
    · right
      exact source_step_11 hcase4 (source_step_10 hcase4)
  exact source_step_12

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 由恒等式 t^6−1=(t−1)(t+1)(t²+t+1)(t²−t+1)，以及 p 为素数且 p|(n^6−1)，p 必整除这四个因子中的至少一个。
情形三，p|(n−1)。则 n≡1 (mod p)，故 n−2≡−1 (mod p)，从而 (n−2)^6≡1 (mod p)。
若 n≥4，则 n−2>1 且 n−2<n，这与 n 的最小性矛盾。
因此此情形只能有 n=2 或 n=3；但 n=2 时 p|1 不可能，故 n=3。
情形四，p|(n²−n+1)。则 n−1≡n² (mod p)，因此 (n−1)^6≡n^12≡1 (mod p)。
若 n≥3，则 1<n−1<n，违反最小性，所以 n=2。
以上四种情形穷尽所有可能，故断言成立。
